show.title: Heated Rivalry
show.synopsis: In the high‑pressure world of professional hockey, two elite players—Shane Hollander and Ilya Rozanov—find themselves locked in a rivalry that has defined their careers. But as competition forces them into constant collision, the line between animosity and attraction blurs. Their journey becomes a tense, emotional exploration of identity, loyalty, and whether love can survive in a world built on winning.

season.description: Season 1 follows Shane and Ilya as their long‑standing rivalry evolves into a connection neither expected. Between road trips, Olympic pressure, media scrutiny, and the emotional cost of secrecy, the season traces how two fiercely competitive athletes navigate desire in a world that demands perfection. Every episode deepens their bond while raising the stakes of what they stand to lose—and what they might finally gain.

episodes.title: Rookies
episodes.summary: Shane Hollander and Ilya Rozanov enter the league as rising stars destined to clash. Their rivalry ignites instantly, fueled by pride, talent, and the pressure to prove themselves. But beneath the sharp edges of competition lies an unexpected spark neither understands. As their first major showdown unfolds, the tension between them becomes impossible to ignore, setting the stage for a connection that defies every rule.

episodes.title: Olympians
episodes.summary: Forced together on the world’s biggest stage, Shane and Ilya struggle to balance their growing secret with the demands of Olympic competition. Their chemistry deepens in stolen moments, but the pressure of representing their countries—and protecting their reputations—pushes them to the edge. As victory and vulnerability collide, they begin to realize their connection is no longer something they can dismiss.

episodes.title: Hunter
episodes.summary: A chance encounter off the ice forces Shane to confront feelings he has tried to bury. Meanwhile, Ilya’s carefully controlled world begins to crack as the emotional weight of their secret relationship grows heavier. Their rivalry becomes increasingly intertwined with desire, leaving both men questioning what they truly want—and whether they can keep pretending their connection is just a passing spark.

episodes.title: Rose
episodes.summary: A moment of raw vulnerability shifts everything between Shane and Ilya, exposing fears neither has dared to voice. As media attention intensifies and a high‑profile romance enters the spotlight, the emotional stakes skyrocket. Their private world begins to fracture under public scrutiny, forcing them to confront the cost of secrecy—and the possibility that their bond may be stronger than the chaos surrounding them.

episodes.title: I'll Believe in Anything
episodes.summary: Shane, Ilya, and Scott each face pivotal crossroads that reshape their futures. For Shane and Ilya, the emotional strain of hiding their relationship reaches a breaking point, forcing them to confront what they’re willing to sacrifice for each other. As personal loyalties collide with professional expectations, every choice becomes a test of trust, courage, and the belief that something real is worth fighting for.

episodes.title: The Cottage
episodes.summary: Escaping to a secluded cottage, Shane and Ilya finally experience a rare moment of peace away from the relentless spotlight. In the quiet, their walls fall away, revealing the depth of what they’ve built together. But as reality looms, they must decide whether this fragile freedom can survive the world waiting outside. Their time together becomes a turning point—one that could redefine everything they know.
